12 Monkeys.cast: Bruce Willis, Madeleine Stowe, Brad Pitt
12 Monkeys.description: A prisoner travels into the past to investigate the origins of a devastating pandemic.

Aliens.cast: Sigourney Weaver, Michael Biehn, Carrie Henn
Aliens.description: Ripley returns to a distant colony with a team of marines to confront a deadly extraterrestrial threat.

Free Guy.description: A video game background character discovers his world is artificial and decides to become its hero.

Frequency.description: A detective discovers a radio connection to his father thirty years in the past, changing both their lives.

Passengers.description: Two passengers awaken prematurely aboard a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony.

The Martian.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must use science and ingenuity to survive until rescue arrives.

ALF.cast: Paul Fusco, Max Wright, Anne Schedeen
ALF.description: A wisecracking alien crash-lands in a suburban family's garage and turns their everyday lives upside down.
